inclusion_rule: For every parent evidence path with a src component, include that module's entire src tree (production code, DTOs, validators, exception mapping, test code and fixtures), its test/tests directories, build descriptors and module docs/README. Include root README/docs/doc/documentation and root build descriptors. Include each parent contract and recursively resolve local $ref files; include referenced parent evidence files even outside src. Include source modules of project-local Java/Kotlin imports to a fixed point, with their tests. Exclude VCS, build output, dependencies, symlinks/submodules, binary files (all sizes), and text blobs over 2 MiB (stronger size cap). Record every excluded selected path. Remove optional cross-item paths and optional files with future references; never remove protected contract/handler evidence. Redact credential values and attribution with line count preserved. No content is taken from a child tree. K order is HMAC-SHA256(salt, original item_id); later-sorted means larger K ID.
limitations: Exact SHA/subject/issue scans do not prove absence of semantic paraphrases.
Lexical credential/attribution scans are not exhaustive personal-data detection.
No upstream source is executed; source completeness is a static module/import rule.
Source dates and identifiers are inherited parent text; no history metadata is exported.
Cross-item decisions conservatively use every changed path regardless of later edits.
ordering: HMAC-SHA256(salt, original item_id), bytewise; IDs reserved before exclusions
